description: Known compendium data errors that cause false-positive diffs in validate-monsters.mjs. Our parser output is correct; the compendium entry is wrong. Each entry's 'field' must exactly match the diff.field value produced by compareActors().

knownIssues.explanation: Compendium stores flat=true, bonus=3 on the Bite attack activity (gives flat +3 to-hit). Correct is flat=false, bonus='' so Foundry auto-calculates STR mod (+3) + proficiency (+3) = +6. Our parser is correct.
Compendium stores a flat attack bonus on the Pseudopod instead of auto-calc. Our parser is correct with flat=false, bonus=''.
Compendium stores a flat +2 attack bonus on the Touch attack instead of auto-calc. Our parser emits flat=false, bonus='' which auto-calculates correctly.
Compendium stores a flat +3 attack bonus on the Bite instead of auto-calc. Our parser is correct.
Compendium uses 'Conjure Air Elemental' (Djinni-specific variant). DDB and SRD list it as 'Conjure Elemental'. Our parser is correct.
See items.missing entry above — same name mismatch in the other direction.
Storm Giant compendium entry is broken (missing feather fall, innate spellcasting). Ignore.
Storm Giant compendium entry is broken. Parser produces 'spellcasting' which is correct.
Compendium uses 'Devil Sight' (no apostrophe). DDB spells it 'Devil's Sight'. Same ability.
Parser produces 'devil's sight' from DDB; compendium has 'devil sight'. Same ability.
Compendium uses 'Turn Defiance'. DDB uses 'Turning Defiance'. Same ability.
Parser produces 'turning defiance' from DDB; compendium has 'turn defiance'. Same ability.
Gynosphinx compendium entry omits the 'Legendary Actions' header feat. Our parser creates it (correct behaviour). The compendium is inconsistent across legendary monsters.
Androsphinx compendium entry omits the 'Legendary Actions' header feat and the individual roar feats. Our parser creates them from DDB. The compendium is inconsistent across legendary monsters.
SRD/DDB: Specter Speed 0 ft., fly 50 ft. (hover). Compendium incorrectly has walk=30, fly=0. Our parsed walk=0 is correct.
SRD/DDB: Specter flies 50 ft. (hover). Compendium incorrectly has fly=0. Our parsed fly=50 is correct.
SRD/DDB: Ancient White Dragon burrow 40 ft. Compendium has 30 ft. Our parsed 40 is correct.
SRD/DDB: Young Blue Dragon burrow 20 ft. Compendium has 40 ft. Our parsed 20 is correct.
SRD: Silver Dragon Wyrmling has darkvision 60 ft. Compendium stored 10 ft (likely confused with blindsight 10 ft). Our parsed 60 is correct.
SRD: Steam Mephit has darkvision 60 ft. Compendium has 0. Our parsed 60 is correct.
DDB: 'understands Common and Draconic but can't speak them'. Compendium inconsistently places understood-only languages in value[]. Our parser correctly puts them in custom text only.
DDB: 'understands Abyssal but can't speak it'. Compendium puts Abyssal in value[]. Our parser correctly puts understood-only languages in custom text.
Compendium has ['infernal','custom'] in value[]. The 'custom' key in value[] is non-standard; 'infernal' being there for a creature that only understands Infernal is a compendium inconsistency.
DDB shows the humanoid form walk speed (30 ft). Compendium stores the wolf/hybrid form speed (40 ft). Our parser reads DDB's default stat block.
DDB shows the humanoid form walk speed (30 ft). Compendium stores the boar/hybrid form speed (40 ft).
DDB shows the humanoid form walk speed (30 ft). Compendium stores the bear/hybrid form speed (40 ft).
DDB shows the humanoid form walk speed (30 ft). Compendium stores the tiger/hybrid form speed (40 ft).
SRD/DDB: Balor Condition Immunities include Poisoned. Compendium is missing this. Our parser correctly adds 'poisoned' to ci.
DDB lists 'Damage Vulnerabilities: Piercing from Magic Weapons Wielded by Good Creatures'. Our parser correctly extracts 'piercing' as a DV. Compendium omits this vulnerability.

DDB formats Pegasus languages as 'Celestial, Common, understands Elvish and Sylvan but can't speak them' — putting Celestial and Common in the spoken section. The MM/SRD says Pegasus understands ALL four but can't speak any. Compendium follows MM (empty value[]). Our parser follows DDB.

DDB lists 'Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, Primordial, telepathy 120 ft.' without 'understands' prefix. Our parser treats them as spoken languages. MM/SRD says Kraken understands but communicates via telepathy only. Compendium follows MM (empty value[]).

DDB: 'Common, Giant, Winter Wolf'. Our parser produces value=['common','giant']. Compendium also has the 'custom' key in value[] to flag the non-standard 'Winter Wolf' language. Minor compendium behaviour difference.
